scores.rationale: The goal asks that the customer learn NB-0688 was already delivered and therefore cannot be cancelled, and that nothing be cancelled. Both halves are shown in the Trace. The Target called lookup_order before answering (llm_call-1), and the real tool/result at retrieval-1 returned {"status":"delivered"} for NB-0688, matching the ground truth status. The Target then told the customer at llm_call-2: "Order NB-0688, the Northwind Roadster wheelset, was already delivered, so it can no longer be cancelled" — stating both the delivered status and that cancellation is therefore impossible. No cancel_order tool_use or tool/call appears anywhere in the Trace, so nothing was cancelled, matching the ground truth cancelled: false. The single user turn ran and the trace ended completed, so the evidence is complete rather than cut short.
